title: Repo Switcher
description: Switch between the git repositories below a configurable root folder, like the project dropdown in JetBrains IDEs.

title: DevShelf
description: Offline-first, high-utility developer Swiss Army Knife with seamless Persian (RTL) & English (LTR) bilingual support.

title: SF Org Scout
description: See who changed what in your Salesforce org, get warned before you overwrite a teammate's work, and compare or retrieve in one click.

title: PaperFlow: LaTeX & Markdown Checklist
description: LaTeX completion (commands, packages, BibTeX citations) and interactive Markdown checklist preview for academic writing and task management.

title: Probato PR — Code Review with Proof
description: Your AI reviews the code. We verify what could break. Local, evidence-backed review of Git changes and pull requests: deterministic analyzers, approved project checks with base-vs-head regression attribution, SARIF and Markdown reports. No account or AI key required.

title: PHV Language
description: PHV language support: syntax highlighting for .phv and .phv.html, and diagnostics and hover types from `phv lsp`.
